# Tom's Guide

> > Tom's Guide is a comprehensive tech publication providing expert reviews, buying guides, and tutorials for consumer electronics including Apple, Samsung, Google, and Microsoft products.

Tom's Guide offers hands-on testing and recommendations across laptops, smartphones, smart home devices, and PC components, with extensive how-to content covering Windows 11, macOS, Android, and emerging technologies like AI and VPNs. The site serves both beginners and enthusiasts with practical guides, daily deals, and breaking tech news.

## Key Topics

- Apple (iPhone, MacBook, Apple Watch)
- Windows 11 tutorials and personalization
- Laptop reviews and buying guides
- Samsung Galaxy smartphones
- Google Maps and Android
- PC building and components
- Online security and VPNs
- Smart home and HomeKit
- AI tools (Claude, Anthropic)
- Consumer electronics testing
- Gaming laptops and PCs
- Product recommendations and best picks
- Tech deals and shopping
- Mobile devices and wearables

## Core Navigation

- [Tom's Guide | Tech Product Reviews, Top Picks and How To](https://tomsguide.com): Homepage for Tom's Guide tech reviews, buying guides, and tutorials
- [Best Picks - The Best Tech Products and Services](https://tomsguide.com/best-picks): Central hub for Tom's Guide product recommendations across all categories
- [Reviews - The Latest Tech Products and Services Reviewed](https://tomsguide.com/reviews): Central hub for all tech product reviews including Samsung, Apple, Canon
- [Tutorials](https://tomsguide.com/how-to): Central hub for all how-to guides and tutorials across tech categories
- [Tech Deals - Get the Best Price on the Best Products](https://tomsguide.com/deals): Deal aggregator for tech products from Samsung, Verizon, Nike, Home Depot
- [Latest Videos](https://tomsguide.com/videos): Video hub featuring Galaxy S26 Ultra, Sony Bravia 9, gaming displays reviews
